column1: # The thirteen `-iree` twin binaries (lake run mnist-iree / cifar-iree / imagenette-iree) under LEAN_MLIR_LOWERER=iree IREE_BACKEND=cuda (sm_86 PTX), IREE 3.12.0, ares (one RTX 4060 Ti each), 2026-11-05.

# Each run: iree-compile of the train step(s) and the forwards, LEAN_MLIR_MAX_EPOCHS=1 (and LEAN_MLIR_G2_STEPS=10 where the trainer takes it: the CIFAR and Imagenette ones), then the full eval. wall is end to end; the step-0 loss is ln 10 plus the head's init; the eval after one short epoch means nothing beyond "the eval forward runs". ms/step is the median over steps 21-60 of a separate 60-step probe (probe/), and the 80-ep column is 295 steps x 80 at that rate, training only.
